title: ChatGPT export branch and role independent tests

commit.message: Add independent ChatGPT export branch and role fidelity tests

findings.summary: Existing ChatGPT tests cover linear node order, user/assistant handles, selected timestamps, image/unsupported mixed parts, slash-id encoding, fallback/duplicate ids, health, tombstones, dirty/missing-id snapshot behavior, and unchanged-export backfill no-op. They do not freeze a branched mapping, conversation_id versus id, same node key across conversations, full CaptureEventInput envelopes, system/tool machine-origin roles, unsupported_role, unsupported-only machine content, or the Core-only origin stamp contract.

Static read of the importer: mapping nodes are identity (conversation id or conversation_id, plus node id); current_node is unused as a filter; user maps to chatgpt:self and assistant to chatgpt:assistant; system and tool are supported machine-origin roles; unknown roles emit unsupported_role with no event; whole-content non-text types emit unsupported_part and empty_content with no event; origin/event_id/content_hash are not connector fields. No production repair is in this packet's write_paths.

independently_specified_expectations.repeat_parse: JSON.stringify of the same branched export yields deep-equal {events, errors}

unsupported_machine_origin.reason: message role is not user, assistant, system, or tool
message has no text or attachments

independently_specified_expectations.origin_contract: events must validate as kizuki.event/v1 ingress and must not carry event_id, content_hash, text_hash, origin, or origin_binding fields

not_duplicated: tombstones, dirty later export, dropped conversation ids

focused_public_behavior.reason: This agent container must not launch tests; root's network-disabled runner owns qualified execution.

package_type_full_gate.reason: Final package, typecheck, and repository gate belong to root's isolated runner and remain separate from this draft candidate.

privacy_diff_integrity.evidence: Diff is a single owned synthetic test file. No credentials, private records, owner-vault paths, or production edits.

independent_review.reason: Author-side elegance pass only; no independent reviewer SHA.

retained_package_consumer.reason: Final compiled package and consumer evidence are out of this packet.
